kill_criteria.expr: certificates are lost or issued again by the move into the group
kill_criteria.observed: checks 7.06, 7.07 passed; ACME test server pebble: no certificate was lost and the CA issued none twice. But a node that enters a group which holds the certificate asks the CA for an order of its own at once (7.04), and two nodes started together both ask (7.10); no second certificate was issued in these runs only because the CA's checks failed (7.08)

notes: Black-box measurement of the group of gateways on real Linux VMs of one lab host (Apple container, one VM per node, HAProxy on a balancer VM, nftables for the edge and for faults, a TUN based delay in place of netem). Development build of schild, never a release. Not the testlab profiles pair and fleet of the spec. Report: tests/results/MVP-27-lab.md. FAIL checks: 1.05, 1.12b, 1.30, 1.33, 3.16, 3.23, 3.26, 3.62, 3.36, 3.43, 3.46, 3.50, 5.13, 7.02, 7.04, 7.05, 7.08, 7.09, 7.10
